verdict.rationale: A government filing service could plausibly offer a documented API sandbox or test environment, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes one: the pack covers only human-facing Gateway portal tips, OHID sign-in, tax services, and robots.txt 403 walls on the Secretary of State's own hosts.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
